A printed page is a fixed canvas, so every line has to earn its place on it. Paragraphs flow from the top margin down until the next line would cross the bottom margin. When that happens the line moves to a fresh page and the paragraph simply continues there.

Margins frame the content and leave space for thumbs, binding and handwritten notes. Links in a document should stay clickable, because a reader expects them to work.
